info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Institution Login Authorization Details-spec
info.description: The Institution Login Authorization Details API provides detailed information regarding the authorization statuses of institution logins. This endpoint allows users to retrieve critical data about which login credentials are authorized for access, ensuring secure interactions within systems. Typical consumers include system administrators and security personnel who need to audit and verify access permissions. By using this API, businesses can effectively manage and monitor authorization details for various institutional accounts.

get.summary: Retrieve authorization details for a specific institution login.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the authorization details associated with the institution login identified by the unique resource identifier. Use this information to understand access permissions and validate user credentials within the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the authorization details for the specific institution login identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the request includes the necessary parameters to fetch the required information accurately.
